title: IDF Drones and Artillery Strike Jabalia, Al-Zawayda, Al-Bureij on Day 965 — 2 Killed, 40 Wounded in 24 Hours
detail: Israeli drones and artillery struck multiple areas of Gaza on June 2, 2026 (Day 965), continuing the daily military operations across the Strip. In Jabalia refugee camp (northern Gaza), Israeli forces set fires to dozens of homes while Apache helicopters circled overhead and a drone dropped explosives on a tent sheltering displaced families. In Al-Zawayda (central Gaza), an IDF drone strike killed one Palestinian, identified as Khamis Joweifil, and wounded two others. In the Al-Bureij refugee camp (central Gaza), a drone targeted a bicycle killing one person; separate Israeli shelling wounded four others including a woman and child in critical condition. In the Zeitoun neighborhood of Gaza City, artillery struck the al-Gharabli family home, wounding two. In Khan Younis, Israeli naval vessels shelled the coastline in an eighth demolition operation. The Gaza Ministry of Health confirmed 2 killed and 40 wounded in the 24-hour reporting period ending June 2. Palestinian sources cite more than 3,000 Israeli ceasefire violations since October 2025; the IDF's count is 139 Palestinian violations.

media.caption: IDF drones and artillery strike Jabalia, Al-Zawayda, Al-Bureij — Day 965, June 2, 2026

title: New Mossad Director Roman Gofman Officially Takes Over on Day 965 — Netanyahu Vows Iran Regime 'Destined to Pass'
detail: New Mossad Director Roman Gofman officially assumed leadership of Israel's intelligence agency on June 2, 2026 (Day 965), following the Supreme Court's clearance on June 1. Netanyahu held a welcoming ceremony for Gofman and declared that Iran's regime is 'destined to pass,' vowing that Israel will help ensure it does. Gofman, a former deputy director, inherits an agency that has carried out the targeted killings of five senior Hamas leaders since October 7, 2023: Ismail Haniyeh (July 2024 in Tehran), Yahya Sinwar (October 2024 in Rafah), Mohammed Sinwar (May 13, 2026 in Khan Yunis), Izz al-Din al-Haddad (May 16, 2026 in Gaza City), and Mohammed Odeh (May 26, 2026 in Rimal). Gofman's Mossad will oversee ongoing intelligence operations against Hamas's remaining military structure, coordination of ceasefire negotiations, and operations against Iran's nuclear and missile programs.

media.caption: New Mossad Director Roman Gofman officially takes over June 2, 2026 as Netanyahu vows Iran regime 'destined to pass'

title: AP Analysis: October 2025 Gaza Ceasefire 'Increasingly Hollow' — Israel Controls 60%+ of Strip, Phase 2 Paralyzed
detail: An AP analysis published June 2, 2026 documented how the October 2025 Gaza ceasefire has become effectively meaningless as a peace instrument. Israel now controls approximately 60% of the Gaza Strip (up from ~50% at signing) while Hamas remains armed. Phase 2 of the peace plan — which was supposed to lead to Hamas disarmament, full Israeli withdrawal, and reconstruction — is completely paralyzed. UN Special Envoy Nickolay Mladenov confirmed in May the plan is 'at a standstill.' The international stabilization force envisioned in the deal has not deployed. The Gaza Board of Peace reconstruction fund has received less than $1 billion of $17 billion pledged. At least 932 Palestinians have been killed and 2,900+ wounded since the ceasefire was supposed to take effect. Hamas and Palestinian Islamic Jihad unanimously rejected the Mladenov disarmament road map, tying any weapons talks to Palestinian statehood and full Israeli withdrawal. The AP analysis noted that the word 'ceasefire' no longer has a consistent meaning — with Israel continuing targeted strikes and military operations while calling them 'security operations' under the ceasefire framework.

media.caption: AP analysis: Gaza October 2025 ceasefire increasingly hollow — Israel holds 60% of Strip, no Phase 2 deal — June 2, 2026
